title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode5 The Sound We're Capable Of

meta.Episode: Episode5 — The Sound We're Capable Of
meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I've improved a lot...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not just my sound either. My fingers are moving much better compared to before, like for the first verse. I'm fretting so smoothly now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should be more than ready for tomorrow when we finally get to practice as a band.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've been able to get so much done during these training sessions...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd been using it for quite a long time... But I bought a replacement, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's proof that I haven't developed thick enough calluses yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if I jumped in by saying Saki made fairly quick work of what was giving her trouble?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're all doing their absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which means tomorrow's practice should...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heya, Shih!
Let's get started with today's practice♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought I was gonna get KAITO again today, but I guess not...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you say so, Shih.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Anyway!
Let's get straight to practicing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since you're gonna be practicing as a band, you girls need to get your respective parts down perfect today☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
I was just thinking the same thing, so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want you to tell me, Rin. How are the others doing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Awesome!
I'm sure tomorrow's gonna go great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because they're all trying really, really, really hard...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm gonna be honest...
I didn't fully comprehend at first just how serious you girls were about making your next show a success.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When I first heard about these training sessions, I thought, “We're gonna get to spend entire days practicing,” and, “This is gonna be so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I realized as time went on that I had the wrong idea. As I practiced with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I realized how serious you all were.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, we played so much together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
We've been at it for like four hours now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! That long?!
We should probably take a break now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Sakki, that reminds me!
Didn't you say you brought over some snacks?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka even said that sweets are good for when you're tired, so let's have some together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, snack time sounds great!
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Can we practice a little more first...?
I wanna review that thing you just taught me one more time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
You're not gonna take a break, Sakki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: At my current playing level, I won't be able to get through to that crowd...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, you can eat without me!
I'll take a break in a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki said that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Weird, right?!
The Sakki I know is usually snacks first, work later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But it wasn't just her...
Hona and Ichi also...
se_event_faith_2022_008

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to stop for a second...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm having trouble staying in rhythm for this part... It sounds a bit uneven when I try to step on the pedals for the hi-hat and bass drum at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, the fourth beat sounded kinda too strong. But I don't think it sounded funny or anything like you said, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
Even though it's really hard to stay in rhythm through that part, you did just fine. So, the next time you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Rin...
I really feel that I need to go over that part again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I want to become a better drummer.
I want to become the musical foundation of our band!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Ichi, you look so cool when playing the guitar!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And your singing voice is so pretty...
I couldn't help but try to sing along!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But this still isn't enough...
The way I'm playing right now... It's nowhere near where I want to be.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember thinking before how beautiful your singing voice was, Rin, and how you sang high notes with so much power...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like your voice could break through the ceiling. Can you teach me how to do that? This song we're working on now has some high parts and I want to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because if I don't, I probably won't feel too confident when I'm on stage. Plus...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's how serious they all are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why I want to do as much as I possibly can to help you girls!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All of you managed to survive the tough tutelage of Ms. Rin, even after she put on her serious face, so I guarantee that you've gotten better!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And that's why I know things are gonna go great!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Shih, it's time for you to show off your amazing bass powers!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme see just how far you've come since we started doing these training sessions♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Get ready.
se_event_faith_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to be just as motivated as the others.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(With all my might...
I have to show just how much I've improved.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our sound needs to resonate with that crowd... It has to show everyone what our music's really about...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More than ever...!)
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(...?!
This sound...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Wh-Whoa...
So this is what happens when Shih gets serious...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whew...
That's it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What did you think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: U-Um...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's wrong?
Is there something that bothered you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Nothing bothered me, but... How do I put it into words...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You don't have to go easy on me.
Just tell me what you felt.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sh-Shih, the way you played was so awesome! Like, I couldn't believe what I heard just now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... It was so awesome that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
S-So...
I really don't know how to describe it... This might just be my imagination...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: B-But, Shih...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
KAITO?!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What am I doing here...?
I thought I was assigned to Shiho today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ah, I knew it...
I was also under the impression that you'd be teaching me today, KAITO, and believed otherwise when Rin came instead.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no! You're right! I made a huge mistake!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hona's gonna get mad at me for being late! Sorry, you two, gotta go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I didn't get a chance to ask...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Was there something you wanted to ask Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't get the way she reacted out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's okay...
We don't have much time, so we should focus on practicing for now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, let's get started...
Is what I'd like to say...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I honestly don't have anything left to teach you, Shiho, so I think you should just have fun and enjoy playing your bass.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Regardless of what happens...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
My goal is to play with everything I have tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, shall we begin our final session...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, please.
se_event_faith_2022_006
